summary: Corrected F-3 Tighten repair artifact. Enumerates the six original controller-ready-frontier acceptance criteria verbatim and attaches the existing implementation and test evidence that was already demonstrated by the completed F-3 turn. No source, test, documentation, or command changes were made during this correction turn.

acceptance_criteria_status.criterion: Only nodes whose dependencies have passed enter the ready frontier.
evidence: src/domains/orchestration/ready-frontier.ts: computeReadyFrontier filters nodes whose depends_on set is a subset of passed node ids

test/orchestration/controller-ready-frontier.test.ts ▶ ready frontier: only roots are ready initially; dependent appears only after every dependency passed; convergence requires all dependencies passed; unrelated branches are independent; ordering is stable regardless of insertion order
F-3-orchestration-tests.log: ready frontier suite passes (5/5)

acceptance_criteria_status.criterion: One deterministic attempt job is emitted per ready node and duplicate delivery is idempotent.
evidence: src/domains/orchestration/dispatch-service.ts: dispatchReadyFrontier derives a single attempt_id per (work_id, node_id, attempt_number) via deriveAttemptId and a single job_id via deriveJobId
src/domains/orchestration/attempt-dispatch.ts: createAttempt enforces the unique (work_id, node_id, attempt_number) constraint
test/orchestration/controller-ready-frontier.test.ts ▶ dispatch service: creates one attempt and one job per ready node; duplicate dispatch is idempotent
F-3-orchestration-tests.log: dispatch service suite passes (3/3)

acceptance_criteria_status.criterion: Pool Worker payloads contain one immutable unit and no DAG topology.
evidence: src/domains/orchestration/index.ts: projectAttemptContract projects a single immutable contract containing only node_id, work_id, attempt_id, attempt_number, repo, branch, intent, acceptance_criteria, and criteria_origin; no depends_on or DAG edges
src/domains/orchestration/contracts.ts: QueueEnvelope is bounded to identifier-only fields (job_id, attempt_id, node_id, work_id)

test/orchestration/controller-ready-frontier.test.ts ▶ worker projection: produces a topology-free contract validated by Agent Execution; produces stable criterion ids; is deeply immutable; ▶ queue schema and rehydration: rehydrates the immutable attempt from SQLite for a valid envelope; rejects content-bearing queue envelopes and tampered target/topology fields
F-3-orchestration-tests.log: worker projection suite passes (3/3); queue schema and rehydration suite passes (7/7)

acceptance_criteria_status.criterion: State transitions use expected-version checks and invalid transitions are rejected.
evidence: src/domains/orchestration/sqlite-store.ts: transitionNode requires an expected_version and rejects STALE_VERSION; the state machine rejects INVALID_TRANSITION

test/orchestration/controller-ready-frontier.test.ts ▶ CAS lifecycle: increments version on valid transition; rejects stale expected version; rejects invalid transitions; ▶ accepted-result recovery and completion authorization: rejects completion when node version has drifted
F-3-orchestration-tests.log: CAS lifecycle suite passes (3/3); accepted-result recovery suite passes (2/2)

acceptance_criteria_status.criterion: Leases and startup reconciliation recover interrupted dispatch/result windows without silently losing work.
evidence: src/domains/orchestration/sqlite-store.ts: claimLease, renewLease, releaseLease, reclaimLease, acceptResult, and completeAuthorizedResult use lease generation/token checks and expected node versions
src/domains/orchestration/reconciliation.ts: reconcile re-enqueues committed attempts missing queue jobs, reclaims expired leases, and completes authorized results exactly once

test/orchestration/controller-ready-frontier.test.ts ▶ lease commands and concurrency; lease-fenced result acceptance; reconciliation; accepted-result recovery and completion authorization; SQLite path safety; migration safety

F-3-orchestration-tests.log: lease commands suite passes (6/6); lease-fenced result acceptance suite passes (9/9); reconciliation suite passes (4/4); accepted-result recovery suite passes (2/2); SQLite path safety suite passes (7/7); migration safety suite passes (6/6)

acceptance_criteria_status.criterion: Otherwise-ready nodes are serialized when versioned controller-owned predicted-touch metadata indicates sufficiently confident likely overlap, without rewriting approved semantic dependency edges; unavailable or low-confidence predictions fall back to optimistic concurrency, and the prediction and serialization decision are durably recorded.
evidence: src/domains/orchestration/contracts.ts: makeEmpiricalSchedulingPolicy classifies overlaps against an injected policy version and minConfidence threshold, returning deterministic 'serialize' or 'optimistic' decisions without mutating dependency edges

src/domains/orchestration/sqlite-store.ts: importPredictedTouch validates evidence provenance (repo, approved_head, gate1_approval_id, graph/manifest/algorithm versions) and records scheduling decisions in the scheduling_decisions table

test/orchestration/controller-ready-frontier.test.ts ▶ predicted-touch scheduling: serializes confident overlapping nodes with valid provenance; selects deterministic node-id winners; falls back optimistically for head/cross-repo/Gate-1/policy-version/low-confidence/direct-task/no-overlap/drift conditions; rejects malformed and oversized evidence; does not insert or modify dependency rows; durably records full provenance; supersedes old blockers
F-3-orchestration-tests.log: predicted-touch scheduling suite passes (25/25)

recommended_next_step: Tighten review (T-3) to confirm the plain-object boundary defect is fully closed and no inherited-field bypass remains.

findings_addressed: shared plain-object boundary defect in orchestration isPlainObject accepted class/Date/attacker-prototype objects
exact-field validators could implicitly read inherited fields from prototype-bearing objects
